posts.title: My first CVE (the bad kind)
posts.description: Let me set the scene: Friday night, after two weeks of fun security issues . A pile of leftover Claude tokens burning a hole in my pocket. A vague feeling that computing as we know it is fundamentally broken. That’s when she walked into my office. Trouble, in a red dress.
